[[File:FibercordWhip-TOR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] uses a fibercord whip against an adversary]]
A '''fibercord''' was a string like material that could be used to link various tools including [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].

==Description==
Fibercord was made using durable fibers such as [[flexisteel]], and was often used in [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hooks]] and other climbing devices.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> It was also used in conjunction with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], to connect two [[Interlocking hilt|paired lightsabers]] together. It was also used to connect a lightsaber to its wielder via their [[Armor/Legends|armor]], or a [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]], which would prevent their opponent from picking it up, or using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] take it.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] used a fibercord [[Interlocking hilt|to connect]] her dual [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] carried a [[Fibercord whip/Legends|fibercord whip]] in their wrist gauntlets.
